# ESP32-C3 Phase A firmware

| File | Flash address |
|------|---------------|
| `firmware_merged_0x0.bin` | `0x0` (all-in-one) |
| `esp32c3-firmware-phase-a.zip` | contains bootloader@0x0, partitions@0x8000, firmware@0x10000 |

Chip: ESP32-C3. Do not connect phone WiFi to SoftAP while flashing (keeps cellular 5G).
